0x000889.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000982.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009FC.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AE3.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000BAC.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000BE7.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C3B.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D8C.en: 「So this is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DBE.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000E38.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E85.en: 「Well, this is trouble. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EC3.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F0A.en: 「For the Granzon... to be shot down...」

0x000FB5.en: 「Kh... To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00106C.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give up. Miscalculated, didn't I.」

0x0010F1.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0011A5.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011DA.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x001297.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012C6.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x001314.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013CF.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013FE.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00143C.en: 「Well now, so this is the end.」

0x00146B.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x0014F6.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00171A.en: 「Guh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001889.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0019AE.en: 「Ratsel, what you wanted to talk to us about...@ is it about Sleigh?」

0x001A36.en: 「Yes, from Arado and the others...@ Sleigh attacked us knowing full well@ that you and the others would be there, didn't she.」

0x001ACF.en: 「Yes... This is what she told me.@　Drag Ibis down from the Altairlion...@　that's the one and only reason she fights.」

0x001B96.en: 「That may be her true feeling, but...@ I suspect there's another reason she's joined@ that group and turned against us.」

0x001C23.en: 「To gather combat data on the Vegalion?」

0x001C69.en: 「...So you were thinking the same thing.」

0x001C94.en: 「Yes. The only ones besides us who could develop the Vegalion@ are <Isurugi Heavy Industries>」

0x001D01.en: 「If they only wanted routine data,@ they'd leave that to us... My guess is they're planning@ to convert the Vegalion for military use somehow.」

0x001DFE.en: 「Could be... I made inquiries to Isurugi,@ but they just kept playing dumb.」

0x001E7B.en: 「Still, the Sleigh and Vegalion matter@ shows a link between that group and Isurugi.@ I'll report this to Gilliam to investigate.」

0x001F51.en: 「After this, we're headed to the Tesla lab, but...@ are you sure you don't want to come along?」

0x001FB3.en: 「I talked it over with Ibis, and...@ we think our odds of running into Sleigh are higher@ if we stay with the Steel Dragon Squadron...」

0x00205B.en: 「...There was a time I thought maybe Sleigh@ was better suited to be the Altairlion's@ test pilot than me, but...」

0x0020FD.en: 「If the Vegalion's being used the wrong way,@ then I have to be the one to stop it...@ with the Altairlion Filio entrusted to me...」

0x0021B4.en: 「...I see.@ Someday, may the light of the stars become one.」

0x002241.en: 「The culmination of Series 77, and a waypoint@ toward making Filio's dream come true, right?@ It all rests on you now.」

0x002332.en: 「I watched the Gaia Sabers' debut battle.@ How does the Air Christmas handle?」

0x0023ED.en: 「Had you left the final outfitting to us,@ I'd be hearing a rather more favorable answer.」

0x00245E.en: 「There's something I need to install@ on our end.」

0x0024A8.en: 「And what would that be?@ Our plant manager suspects it may be something@ on the scale of a shipborne <Tesla Drive>」

0x00254C.en: 「Company secret.@ More to the point, that's not why you're really here, is it?」

0x0025A8.en: 「No. I came hoping you'll formally approve@ construction of the second Air Christmas.」

0x00262B.en: 「I'd been thinking the other all-purpose carriers@ would be the captured Trilobite-class and ships based on it.」

0x0026B7.en: 「My... Should the President's own personal unit@ really be using ships of such dubious origin?」

0x002734.en: 「With the budget to consider,@ I'm hardly in a position to be picky.」

0x00278A.en: 「I'll have our people revise the estimate@ to fit your wishes.」

0x0027E9.en: 「We prioritized the production line for the@ next-gen Lion, the 'Relion,' and provided@ the Kerberion as well.」

0x002888.en: 「And we hope to give the Gaia Sabers@ even greater cooperation going forward.」

0x0028F6.en: 「The Relion aside, the Kerberion offers us@ the benefit of collecting operational data,@ does it not?」

0x00297A.en: 「If you approve this,@ we'll offer a high-speed combat armored module@ we're developing, as a sample - pilot included.」

0x002A71.en: 「You're aware of the interstellar voyage plan,@ <Project TD>, I trust?」

0x002AD6.en: 「The true aims of Series 77, 'Alpha' and 'Beta'...@ this is a high-performance machine based on the latter.」

0x002B57.en: 「Its mobility, maneuverability, and range beat@ any armored module before it, and it wields@ a new weapon: the MTD guided missile.」

0x002C39.en: 「Micro Tesla Drive Missile...@ Just as the name says, it's a weapon that turns@ the Tesla Drive itself into a missile.」

0x002CE1.en: 「There aren't many machines that can escape one,@ you know?」

0x002D34.en: 「So you throw away a Tesla Drive with each shot.@ Sounds expensive.」

0x002D8A.en: 「That's its one drawback...@ though this time we'll include it among the samples.」

0x002DFB.en: 「Then submit the detailed specifications.@ I'll weigh the second ship after I've seen them.」

0x002E72.en: 「Thank you.@ I look forward to our continued dealings...」

0x002ECF.en: 「...The president herself handling sales. Quite dedicated.」

0x002F06.en: 「She came to probe us. If she's picked up on something@ from the Air Christmas spec changes...@ she's an even sharper woman than the rumors say.」

0x002FB7.en: 「Surely she couldn't tell that much from just that...」

0x002FEB.en: 「Either way, it's only a matter of time.@ Now then... what did you have to report?」

0x003044.en: 「The Steel Dragon Squadron has returned to the surface.」

0x00307B.en: 「Ho... At this timing, no less.@ Just as the Gamma Sabers' <Boosted Children>@ said they would.」

0x003147.en: 「Indeed... Less forced than the one@ we'd prepared ourselves.」

0x00319A.en: 「Then shall we put the plan into motion?」

0x0031D4.en: 「No, not yet. We're missing a piece.@ Thanks to that defective unit's meddling.」

0x00323C.en: 「For Duvan to act on his own...@ Perhaps Dr. Ozunu's death is a root cause,@ and his ego has grown stronger.」

0x0032D2.en: 「But as I reported before, we've confirmed@ the escape pod was most certainly launched.」

0x00335C.en: 「Still, Duvan's interference created a time lag.@ The odds they made contact before the Steel Dragon Squadron@ went missing are low.」

0x003419.en: 「This is hard to say, but...@ there's also the possibility of death...」

0x00346F.en: 「Number 22 is a rare specimen with high-level@ latent T-a waves that control even burst waves,@ gained through natural mutation, not artificial.」

0x003534.en: 「Though we used an improved base body from the@ Machinery Children, we applied no enhancement@ measures, to conceal its origins, and yet...」

0x0035D0.en: 「Even so, it shows high survivability naturally.@ And it's flexible even against the <Rimacon>」

0x00364C.en: 「A talent one might call heaven-sent... and the most@ effective factor to draw out that power is the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x0036E1.en: 「Find the unit at once, and steer it toward contact with them.@ We move to the plan's next phase only after that's done.」

0x003783.en: 「Also, order Kenneth in Izu to keep the Hagane@ Squadron on standby at Hickam Base. I want them@ kept close at hand, ready for what's to come.」

0x00385F.en: 「And... inform the President of the@ Grand Christmas inspection.@ Transport will be by Air Christmas.」

0x003914.en: 「One last thing...@ Any new findings regarding the ruins?」

0x003967.en: 「The Nafud Desert, off the Bermuda Islands, Antarctica...@ At present there's nothing notable to report.」

0x0039DE.en: 「Bermuda's a long shot.@ Nafud or Antarctica... it's one of those two.」

0x003A43.en: 「Since the Demon appeared, the LTR Organization@ seems to suspect Nafud is the likeliest, but...」

0x003AD6.en: 「If so, the survey team could well be wiped out@ by now. I'm not convinced yet...」

0x003BAA.en: 「AI1's education seems to be progressing smoothly.」

0x003BF7.en: 「Yes, it will soon shift to Level 3.@ There are no problems.」

0x003C63.en: 「No... If Hugo Medio notices my existence,@ he'll cast an even more suspicious eye on the project.」

0x003CF8.en: 「No need to worry.@ Whatever Lieutenant Hugo thinks of me,@ he has no choice but to obey. To get the drug.」

0x003D8B.en: 「It's not just him. The <Special Combat Instruction Corps>,@ and the Steel Dragon Squadron too,@ grow more suspicious by the day, I'd wager.」

0x003E10.en: 「That we can clear up with future results.@ The Gaia Sabers will become the vanguard@ of Earth's defense...」

0x003E97.en: 「Under the President, once we drive off outside enemies,@ a few small flaws will cease to matter.」

0x003F02.en: 「And... your son will go on living, too.」

0x003F3F.en: 「You understand, I trust, that if you don't@ follow our instructions...」

0x003F95.en: 「You needn't tell me. But there is a chance@ of recovery, isn't there?」

0x003FEE.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo is the grounds for that.@ That said, your son was as good as a corpse...@ Waking him will take considerable time.」

0x0040A5.en: 「As before, trust me and leave it in my hands.」

0x0040FB.en: 「......Still, isn't there a problem with the choice?@　The Zentr Project and the Cry Wolves@　have bad blood between them.」

0x0041A0.en: 「That's exactly why they're easy to handle.」

0x00422A.en: 「I simply think she's unsuited@　to be AI1's opponent.@　Why put the TE engine in that machine?」

0x0042CC.en: 「Leaving its control to AI1 as well@　would surely yield far better results.」

0x00433A.en: 「It's a handicap. As things stand, it's no fair match.@　Besides, could AI1 as it is now really@　comprehend and control the DFC System?」

0x004431.en: 「Human intuition can, at times, surpass a machine.@　Lieutenant Aqua's data will one day@　prove invaluable to AI1.」

0x0044DF.en: 「Then do you intend to entrust@　Units 8 and 9 to them as well?」

0x004532.en: 「Yes, for now.@ Unit 10...... MODEL-X,@ that depends on the results.」

0x0045AA.en: （So this is what Fau Kern really is......@　using something this dangerous as a power source......）

0x004624.en: （I can't believe Dr. Ozunu approved this......@　Could it be interference from@　the Zentr Project......?）

0x00477F.en: 「Ariel...... so it was you after all.」

0x0047C9.en: 「Now, would you lower that gun?@　I've no intention of raising an alarm.」

0x004835.en: 「Not only sneaking in here, but cracking@　the protection too. Impressive, as expected.」

0x0048B3.en: 「......Were you looking into why@　Dr. Ozunu was killed?」

0x00494F.en: 「Mm.@　That man had come to doubt@　the very nature of the Gaia Sabers......」

0x005057.en: 「Well, as you can see, it's a patchwork job.」

0x0052D9.en: 「B-but, suspicion will fall on you, doctor.」

0x0054FA.en: 「N-now, hurry and go......@　The rest is up to you......」

0x005584.en: （Th-this was the right thing, wasn't it, Enji Ozunu......）

0x005688.en: 「Bah, I'll be up and about in another week.@　More to the point, forgive me. I was right there,@　yet the RyuOhKi and KoOhKi ended up in ruins......」

0x006126.en: 「That's right. Like the Mk-III, we meant to finish it@　as a high-performance machine with a T-LINK System.」

0x0061B5.en: 「If there's anything I can help with, just say so.」

0x0061FE.en: （If everyone here joins forces,@　the Ash is sure to......）

0x0065F0.en: （......Seems like an honest boy.@　But what kind of past could he have had......）

0x00700C.en: 「When it comes to dancing, I won't lose! Get ready!!」

0x007477.en: 「Ing, I'm counting on you for cover!」

0x0074A6.en: 「...Not fools enough to fall for a mere feint, then.@　That 'Key' doesn't seem to be here, but@　there are several strong casters among them.」

0x008234.en: 「Next time we meet,@　you'll tell me your name... girl of the Azure Dragon.」

0x00828D.en: (The presence is gone...?@　Something other than the Yokijin was there...?)

0x008380.en: 「...Dawn's almost here.@　I just hope nothing happens before the Kurogane@　gets back...」
